- Practical experience in other areas such as API, database, web, mobile, integration, end-to-end, data, security, or production testing.

title: Senior Application Security Engineer (OWASP, CI/CD)
description:
## Company

Crossian is a technology-driven e-commerce business founded in 2020. It operates in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

## Details

- **Location:** Ha Noi
- **Seniority/Level:** Senior Application Security Engineer
- **Work model:** At office

## Responsibilities

**Secure SDLC & DevSecOps**
- Define security requirements, security gates, and design reviews across the design, development, testing, and deployment stages of the SDLC.
- Integrate and automate SAST, DAST, SCA, secret scanning, and container/IaC scanning in CI/CD pipelines. Tune findings to reduce false positives and improve developer workflows.

**Security assessment & penetration testing**
- Assess and penetration-test web and mobile applications, APIs, and backend services using OWASP guidance, with attention to authentication, authorization, and business logic.
- Perform manual and automated security code reviews of high-risk functionality. Help developers identify root causes and implement effective remediation.

**Vulnerability lifecycle management**
- Manage application vulnerabilities from discovery, validation, and risk-based prioritization through remediation, retesting, and closure against agreed SLAs. Escalate overdue findings and track approved exceptions.
- Assess risks in third-party libraries, open-source dependencies, and software components using Software Composition Analysis (SCA) and Software Bills of Materials (SBOMs).

**Cloud workload security**
- Assess and implement security controls for application workloads on cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
- Partner with DevOps to review containers, Kubernetes, serverless services, IAM/service identities, secrets, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) against security baselines.

**Incident response & collaboration**
- Support application security incident investigations. Use lessons learned to strengthen preventive controls and development practices.
- Coordinate external penetration tests, including scope definition, findings follow-up, and remediation retesting.
- Provide practical secure coding guidance, training, and support to engineering teams.

## Requirements / Qualifications

**Experience level**
- **Intermediate:** Typically 3+ years of relevant experience. Able to deliver defined assessments and security improvements, with guidance on complex decisions.
- **Senior:** Typically 5+ years. Demonstrated ownership of application security practices, complex assessments, and cross-team remediation.

**Required**
- Hands-on application/API penetration testing and security code review experience, with strong knowledge of OWASP guidance, authentication, authorization, and business-logic vulnerabilities.
- Experience integrating and tuning security testing tools in CI/CD pipelines and applying Secure SDLC practices.
- Experience validating, prioritizing, and tracking vulnerabilities through verified closure, including dependency risk management using SCA/SBOM.
- Working knowledge of at least one major cloud platform, container/Kubernetes security, IAM, secrets management, and IaC review.
- Ability to read application code and write scripts to automate security tasks.
- Clear communication and reporting skills. Able to explain risk, recommend practical fixes, and collaborate with developers and stakeholders.

**Preferred**
- Experience with mobile application testing, threat modeling, or application security incident investigations.
- Relevant application security, penetration testing, or cloud security certifications are welcome but not required.

## Benefits

- 13th-month salary and performance bonus
- 15 paid leave days
- Health insurance
- Budget for learning and professional growth

title: Middle to Senior Data Analyst (SaaS, US product)
description:
## Company

Flodesk is a profitable, fast-growing SaaS company that builds email marketing software used by thousands of small businesses. Its Data Team sits within the Engineering team in the Da Nang office and serves as the company's single source of truth for data-driven insights across Product, Marketing, Finance, and Engineering. The company works closely with its US and EU teams.

## Details

- **Location:** Da Nang, Vietnam
- **Seniority/Level:** Middle to Senior
- **Work model:** At office

## Responsibilities

As a Data Analyst, you will translate raw data into meaningful insights, optimize data pipelines, and maintain a self-service BI ecosystem that enables teams to explore and understand data effectively.

**Financial metrics and modeling**
- Own the dbt models behind Flodesk's financial metrics, including MRR and its movements, billings, collected payments, retention, LTV, and CAC.
- Build these metrics from Recurly billing data so they hold up in real-world cases such as plan changes, failed payments, and refunds, and so the same month shows the same number in every report.

**Revenue and cost reconciliation**
- Reconcile billings, collected payments, and MRR against the billing system, payment processors, and accounting records, and explain any gap in terms Finance can act on.
- Apply the same reconciliation to costs so that unit economics, such as affiliate commissions, rest on numbers everyone trusts.

**Finance partnership**
- Work directly with the Finance Director and leadership on metric definitions, cohort and pricing analysis, and recurring reporting.
- When a definition is genuinely open (for example, how to count a member who converts and cancels in the same month), lay out the options and trade-offs, help Finance decide, and document the decision so it sticks.
- Partner with Marketing on acquisition spend and attribution for CAC.

**Beyond finance**
- Support other domains as needed, such as product and growth analytics, applying the same rigor to questions about feature adoption, funnels, and retention.

**AI-first analytics**
- Do most of your building and analysis through AI agents rather than by hand.
- Direct agents to write and review dbt models, run investigations, and build dashboards, and own the results by checking the logic, testing edge cases, and catching what the agent got wrong.

**Self-serve analytics**
- Help replace traditional BI with a self-hosted portal of Claude-built dashboards and an analytics MCP that answers ad hoc questions in plain language.
- Build and maintain the finance dashboards, and curate the metric definitions, model metadata, and guardrails that keep MCP answers accurate.

## Requirements / Qualifications

- Analytics experience, ideally in subscription or SaaS finance.
- A fast learner with an open mind. Prior experience with subscription metrics such as MRR, LTV/CAC, or billing reconciliation is welcome but not required.
- Advanced SQL and data modeling skills, including choosing the right grain for each table and getting snapshot and point-in-time logic right.
- dbt experience is a strong plus (the stack is dbt on Redshift and ClickHouse). Python is a plus.
- Experience doing analytics work through AI agents (such as Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) is highly desirable. Experience building an analytics MCP server or semantic layer for LLM use is a further advantage. In either case, you should have the judgment to check an agent's output rather than trust it.
- Rigor and healthy skepticism: when numbers don't tie, you keep digging until you can explain the gap, and you are upfront about caveats and definitional choices instead of presenting one tidy number.
- Clear written and spoken English. You can explain a metric definition to Finance without jargon and write documentation that people and agents can rely on.

## Benefits

- Highly competitive salary, plus a 13th-month bonus.
- Stock options for high contributors.
- Professional development budget of up to $1,000 per year for courses, books, or conferences.
- Healthcare: annual health check, vaccinations, premium health insurance, and family health insurance covering up to 2 family members.
- Flexible working hours with a standard 5-day workweek.
- Equipment: a MacBook Pro, a Mac Studio for running AI agents (for most engineering roles), and an external screen in the modern office.
- Career growth opportunities, including overseas opportunities.

- **Passkey/FIDO2:** Build WebAuthn registration and login flows, including step-up authentication for sensitive operations.
- **mTLS integrations:** Implement certificate-based service-to-service authentication with external financial platforms.
- **Shared security library:** Build a Spring Boot starter that provides standardized authentication filters across all backend services.
- **Integration testing:** Create Karate-based test suites covering all authentication flows at scale.

**Must-have**

- 10+ years in server-side engineering, including 5 to 7 years specializing in Kotlin or Java with Spring Boot development.

- PostgreSQL experience, including schema design and migrations.
- REST API design and HTTP security headers.
- Fluent English (reading, writing, and verbal). English is the primary working language for daily communication, code reviews, and technical documentation across the team and organization.

**Security and authentication (strong)**

- Strong Spring Security expertise, including filter chains and OAuth2 Resource Server.
- Working knowledge of OAuth 2.0 and OIDC, including authorization code, client credentials, token exchange, and introspection.
- Understanding of at least one of: DPoP (RFC 9449), mTLS (RFC 8705), PKCE, FIDO2/WebAuthn.
- Familiarity with JWT structure, including claims, JWKS, and key rotation.
- Strong knowledge of authentication, authorization, session management, and secure web application development.
- Strong understanding of the OWASP Top 10, including common web vulnerabilities, mitigations, and secure coding practices.
- AWS experience, including ECS/Fargate, Secrets Manager, and VPC basics.
- Terraform or similar infrastructure-as-code tools.
- API integration testing experience (Karate preferred).

**Nice-to-have**

- Experience with Authlete or the FAPI 2.0 Security Profile, or other financial-grade API standards.

- Cloudflare or Akamai experience, including mTLS termination, WAF, and client certificate forwarding.

description:

## Responsibilities

- Own QA delivery and performance across twelve product lines and the automation and performance functions.
- Develop five team leads: set goals, hold one-to-ones, make performance decisions, and handle hiring. Two of them will be new hires you inherit within their first months.
- Own your teams' targets against the organization's QA scorecard. Set them, review them per team, and hit them. Focus on quality outcomes, not case counts.
- Own how QA works day to day within the release train model: defect lifecycle, test execution, triage, estimation and self-estimation, review discipline, and reporting. Argue for changes to the model itself. The VP owns the model.
- Build specification review and estimation capability in your leads until area-level scoping no longer routes through the VP.
- Raise automation share and throughput per engineer. Make testing cycles faster without sacrificing coverage or confidence.
- Own QA's side of escaped defect analysis. Every customer escape should lead to a change in what QA does. Partner with Support on recurring and high-impact issues and feed the patterns back across all teams.
- Work with Product and Development to review requirements through a customer-impact lens. Improve defect prevention, not just detection.
- Prepare the quarterly business review and co-present your teams' numbers with the VP, who owns the QA story told to the executive team.
- Prepare the quality evidence the VP needs for release go/no-go decisions. You do not make the ship call.
- This is not a hands-on testing role. Expect under 10% hands-on work: enough to maintain technical credibility with your leads, but not enough to do their jobs. You will be judged on what your six people and their teams produce.

## Requirements / Qualifications

**Required:**

- 8 or more years in software quality assurance, including 3 or more years managing managers or team leads (not only engineers) in a software product organization.
- A track record of raising a QA organization's output, with numbers: throughput per engineer, automation share, reduction in escaped defects, and cycle time. Experience building QA processes where none existed.
- An automation-first delivery approach and the ability to increase test volume rather than reduce it. The scale is roughly 1,000 test cases per feature, about 3,900 cases in the quarterly release train scope, and about 1,650 for the largest single product line. Describe how you would produce and manage this, for example through AI-assisted generation, templates, parallel execution, and risk prioritization.
- QA-side ownership of escaped defects: when a defect reaches a customer, you change what QA does, not only what Product and Development do.
- English strong enough to hold your own in front of the CEO. You will co-present the quarterly business review and negotiate with Product and Development leadership.
- Daily use of AI tools in your work (such as Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, Cursor, or Atlassian Rovo). You should be able to explain where AI fits in your workflow, what you review before trusting its output, and what you tried that did not work.
- Comfort being accountable for other people's teams, including hiring, performance decisions, and difficult calls, such as managing a senior technical specialist who knows the product better than you do.

**Desired:**

- Experience with enterprise or on-premises software shipped to environments you cannot access after release. A bad build cannot be fixed overnight.
- Experience working closely with Support or Customer Success on escaped-defect analysis.
- Familiarity with cloud storage platforms (such as AWS S3, Wasabi, or Azure) and hypervisors (such as VMware, Hyper-V, Proxmox, or Nutanix).
- Experience with test management at scale, using Xray or similar tools.

The Analytics Engineer will bridge the gap between the raw data pipelines built by Data Engineering and the analytical and operational needs of Product Managers, LiveOps, User Acquisition (UA), and Leadership. The role involves transforming complex, high-volume player behavioral telemetry and business data into clean, well-documented, tested, and standardized dimensional models. The role also includes pioneering the development of the company's "insight stack," which maps data models and business questions into Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools and AI agent workflows to turn raw telemetry into reliable, automated, self-serve business insights.

### 1. Data Modeling & Semantic Layer Architecture & Maintenance

- Maintain model health, cost, and query performance: optimize BigQuery execution (partitioning, clustering, incremental builds) while ensuring data freshness SLAs and anomaly monitoring.
- Enforce software engineering rigor across analytics: modular dbt development, automated CI/CD testing, Git version control, and peer code reviews.

### 2. Insight Stack & AI-Powered Decision Infrastructure

- Collaborate with data leadership to design and evolve the "insight stack," connecting structured data assets to AI agents and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools.
- Translate recurring stakeholder decision flows (across Product, LiveOps, UA, and Management) into standardized inputs, queries, validation rules, and structured outputs for automated agent execution.
- Build tool schemas, prompts, and execution flows enabling AI agents to query verified datasets, run comparative checks, and draft decision-ready summaries.
- Establish guardrails, data validation, and permission boundaries ensuring AI agents operate safely without unmonitored raw database access.

### 3. Data Quality, Testing & Verification

- Establish comprehensive automated testing frameworks (dbt tests, schema validation, data integrity rules) to safeguard data reliability and timeliness across all core data marts.
- Define evaluation criteria and test suites to benchmark AI agent outputs against ground-truth queries, dashboards, and analyst outputs.
- Build alerting and monitoring systems for data discrepancies, silent schema drift, and telemetry anomalies, driving swift incident resolution.
- Document assumptions, data lineage, edge cases, and handoff criteria between automated agent analysis and human analyst

- Build evaluation into every AI feature: offline eval sets, regression tests, and LLM-as-judge where it fits. Monitor quality, latency and cost in production.
- Own AI safety and data governance: scope data access by user permissions, expose only allowlisted fields to models, defend against prompt injection, and handle sensitive data correctly.
- Build data and algorithm pipelines on event streams (Kafka/CDC) and relational data. Backtest recommendations against historical data before go-live.

**Backend engineering**

- Build and maintain high-throughput, mission-critical Go services in a microservice, event-driven architecture.
- Tune performance across services, databases and caches. Troubleshoot production incidents and drive refactoring.
- Write clean, tested, maintainable code. Review code and raise the engineering bar of the team.

**Engineering with AI**

- Use AI coding agents every day across the development lifecycle: spec, code, test, review, debug.
- Build internal tools, prompts and workflows that make the whole team faster, while keeping quality under control.

**Collaboration**

- Work with Product Owners, business and operations teams to turn vague problems into measurable AI solutions.
- Explain model results and trade-offs in plain business language.

## Requirements / Qualifications

**Must have**

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT or equivalent.
- 4+ years of backend development, including at least 3 years building production Go applications.

**Strong**

- Distributed-systems fundamentals: microservices, event-driven architecture, Kafka or a similar message broker, gRPC/REST, concurrency and parallel programming.
- Solid database skills: PostgreSQL (query design, indexing, performance tuning), at least one NoSQL database, and distributed caching such as Redis.
- Hands-on experience shipping at least one LLM-based feature to production, not only a prototype. This includes prompt design, tool or function calling, RAG and structured outputs, plus a clear understanding of the limits: hallucination, latency, and token cost.
- Hands-on experience with agent frameworks, Model Context Protocol (MCP) and multi-agent systems, and with vector search (e.g. pgvector) for retrieval.
- A measure-first mindset: you prove an AI or algorithm change with data and evaluation before calling it done.
- Good data skills (SQL, Python) to analyse data, build datasets and run backtests.
- Ability to drive technical solutions independently and troubleshoot complex issues with minimal supervision.
- Daily use of AI coding tools (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) and good judgement on when to trust their output.
- Good cross-team communication skills.

**Nice to have**

- Classic ML or optimisation (forecasting, recommendation, operations research).
- Big-data and OLAP technologies (e.g. BigQuery, ClickHouse).
- Docker, Kubernetes and cloud platforms (GCP, AWS).
- Frontend work with React/TypeScript when needed.

## Company

## Details

- **Location:** Ha Noi
- **Level:** Middle
- **Work model:** At office
- **Experience:** 3+ years in QA/testing

## Responsibilities

This role leads quality assurance for a re-platforming project for a national public-sector system in the EU. The legacy system, about 750 screens of a client-server 4GL application (Uniface), is being rebuilt as a modern Java/Spring and React application on an Oracle database. The central question is whether the new system does exactly what the old one does. Each migration wave must meet that bar before going live. Because the scope includes thousands of business rules, verification must be automated and repeatable, so the QA lead will build the test system that compares old and new behavior on every wave. That system does not exist yet and will be built in this role.

- Design the test architecture and set up an AI-driven workflow that turns business rules into executable tests at scale.
- Lead two QA/BA engineers who work within the test system.
- Make the go / no-go decision for every migration wave.
- Work from the specification owned by the BA Lead, and return it when it is not testable.
- Test each migration wave against the legacy system and verify that the new system behaves as expected.
- Design and execute functional, regression, integration, and exploratory tests.
- Create detailed test cases and test scenarios based on business requirements and specifications.
- Investigate the legacy application to understand existing workflows, validations, and business rules.
- Compare old and new system behavior and identify functional differences.
- Check data directly in Oracle using SQL to verify that records and business results are correct.
- Report defects clearly, including steps to reproduce, expected results, actual results, and supporting evidence.
- Retest fixes and perform regression testing before releases.
- Support UAT with the client, including test scenario preparation, execution, and issue tracking.
- Work closely with developers and BA team members to analyze and resolve defects.
- Contribute to the automated regression suite and gradually expand automation coverage.
- Maintain test documentation and ensure adequate coverage for each migration wave.
- Use AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude to support test case creation, test analysis, documentation, and repetitive QA activities.

## Requirements / Qualifications

- 3+ years of experience in QA/testing, preferably on business-critical or enterprise applications.
- Strong understanding of software testing principles, methodologies, and QA processes.
- Ability to analyze business requirements and translate them into meaningful test scenarios and test cases.
- Experience with functional and regression testing of web or business applications.
- Good SQL skills and the ability to independently verify data in a relational database.
- Strong attention to detail and a structured approach to investigating issues.
- Ability to understand complex business processes and identify missing or unclear requirements.
- Experience using Jira / Confluence and test management tools such as Xray, TestRail, or similar.
- Good communication skills and the ability to work closely with developers, BAs, and business stakeholders.
- Fluent English.
- Comfortable working AI-first and using AI tools regularly to improve productivity and testing quality.
- Skills: Java, Selenium, and automation testing.

Nice to have:

- Experience with test automation using Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, or similar.
- API testing experience with REST / Postman / Newman, or similar.
- Basic scripting or programming knowledge.

title: Expert, AI Engineering
description:
## Company

Techcombank is a commercial bank in Vietnam that provides banking and financial services and invests heavily in technology and large-scale IT projects.

## Details

- **Location:** Ha Noi
- **Seniority/Level:** Expert
- **Work model:** At office

## Responsibilities

**Job purpose**

- Lead the design and delivery of advanced AI solutions, ensuring high performance, scalability, and cost efficiency in production environments.
- Solve complex AI challenges (modeling, evaluation, multi-agent systems) and develop reusable frameworks and standards adopted across teams.
- Ensure AI systems are developed and operated responsibly, addressing safety, ethical risks, and governance requirements.

**AI Craft – Specialization**

- Evaluate novel algorithms and training techniques against production constraints. Diagnose and unblock the hardest cross-cutting modeling problems (severe distribution shift, low-resource settings, multi-task architecture). Build reusable modeling patterns adopted across teams.
- Implement complex multi-agent orchestration, long-running stateful workflows, and quality optimization at scale. Evaluate new models and frameworks hands-on. Build reusable agent patterns and prompt libraries adopted across teams.
- Evaluate and adopt advanced optimization techniques. Design multi-tenant serving and capacity strategies. Build performance-regression frameworks and cost dashboards adopted across teams.
- Act as the recognized expert in the sub-domain within the organization. Select between competing approaches based on production constraints. Review and unblock others' sub-domain work. Tackle the harder problems (low-resource scenarios, distribution shift, real-time constraints). Serve as the person teams escalate to.

**AI Craft – Evaluation**

- Build evaluation tooling and automated experiment pipelines adopted across teams.
- Design and run online A/B tests with statistical rigor. Calibrate human and LLM-judge evaluation.
- Resolve the hardest evaluation problems (subjective tasks, rare-event detection, long-tail safety).

**Engineering for Production**

- Design testing strategies for AI systems (data validation, model regression, prompt-output, agent-trajectory tests). Evaluate and introduce new tooling. Build internal libraries, SDKs, and code templates that raise the engineering baseline across teams.
- Architect data platforms that serve both ML training and LLM/RAG workloads. Design for cost, latency, and freshness trade-offs. Build reusable data-quality, lineage, and observability tooling adopted across teams.
- Architect complex AI systems combining ML and agentic components. Design for graceful degradation, cost efficiency, evolvability, and multi-tenancy. Build reference implementations and integration patterns adopted by other teams. Lead the migration and convergence of inherited or siloed systems where warranted. Balance near-term delivery against long-term architectural coherence.

**Research, Emerging Technologies, and AI Safety, Ethics & Responsible AI**

- Conduct in-depth evaluation of emerging AI technologies within the assigned domain or project. Build prototypes to validate feasibility and risks. Recommend appropriate implementation approaches for specific use cases.
- Contribute to the development and refinement of responsible AI standards within the domain. Ensure solutions comply with established guidelines and regulations.
- Analyze ethical and safety risks of AI systems at the solution and project level. Propose appropriate risk mitigation measures.
- Participate in designing and executing testing activities (e.g., adversarial testing, risk assessments) to improve system robustness and reliability.
- Support AI risk assessments in product reviews, acting as a technical advisor within the domain.

  - Production operations: monitoring, troubleshooting
  - Security: secure coding, IAM, secrets management

## Benefits

- Professional work attitude and strong information security awareness; able to work independently and in a team.

title: BLOCKCHAIN SOFTWARE ENGINEER (Senior/Expert)
description:
## Company

Techcom Securities (TCBS) is a Vietnamese securities company offering trading and investment services and financial products, including stocks, bonds, fund certificates, and related structured products. The company is building its own technology platform.

## Details

- **Location:** Ha Noi, Vietnam
- **Level:** Senior / Expert
- **Work model:** On-site (at office)

## Responsibilities

As a Software Engineer, you will be part of a team with broad technical skills and will take part in the full development lifecycle: researching business needs, understanding product goals, designing architecture, building products, and optimizing systems while customers use them.

The company is pursuing a strategy of building its own technology platform. Software engineers model trading and investment business processes, build platforms and API systems, and develop features for financial products such as stocks, bonds, fund certificates, and related structured products. As a Blockchain Software Engineer, you will directly develop products for the company's cryptocurrency (crypto) projects.

The company is a technology pioneer. Candidates will be trained and provided with AI tools, and are expected to apply AI effectively in their work to improve quality and efficiency.

**Software Design & Development**
- Work closely with business teams to model product requirements and deliver optimal, secure, and highly scalable design solutions.
- Write and update technical documentation, API specifications, and data designs.
- Develop systems related to digital assets and blockchain, such as tokenization platforms, custody systems, and crypto asset trading exchange systems.
- Take part in architecture and source code reviews within your own team and across the technology department.

**Testing & Quality Assurance**
- Write test cases, develop automated tests, and perform integration and functional testing for software systems.
- Ensure the quality of product deliverables, and monitor and resolve software defects (if any) during customer use.

**AI in Software Development**
- Build knowledge and skills to use AI tools effectively in software development.
- Build and refine AI workflows suited to your work, and share them with your team, the technology department, and the wider company.

**Collaboration & Operations**
- Proactively ensure delivery of your individual work and the projects you are involved in.
- Coordinate with the operations team during deployment, and monitor and handle related incidents.
- Proactively research new technologies and propose strategies for applying them to products.

## Requirements / Qualifications

**Education & Experience**
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or an equivalent field.

- Take part in hiring and onboarding, and build a collaborative, high-performing team.

- Stay up to date with .NET, Angular, and AI tooling, and share ideas on how to apply them in the company's products.

## Requirements / Qualifications

**Must have**

- Proficiency in C#, ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework Core, and Dapper. Strong understanding of OOP, SOL

title: Senior DevOps & Infrastructure Engineer
description:
## Company

**Reclub Vietnam** operates Reclub, a social sports platform that helps people organize activities, discover communities, and play together. The platform aims to make recreational sports more accessible, social, and enjoyable.

## Details

- **Location:** Ho Chi Minh City (The Sun Avenue, 28 Mai Chi Tho, Binh Trung Ward)
- **Seniority/Level:** Senior
- **Working time:** 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, Monday to Friday
- **Work model:** Hybrid. Three onsite days shared with the engineering team. Releases and on-call are remote.

## Responsibilities

This role owns infrastructure, reliability, deployments, monitoring, and on-call. It is the company's first dedicated infrastructure hire. The platform is currently run part-time by the engineers who built it. It works, but parts of the estate are still manual, backups are not drill-tested enough, and access controls need tightening. The focus of this role is to close that gap: take ownership of production infrastructure, turn repeated manual work into code, improve operational safety, and build the runbooks and documentation the team can rely on.

Releases are currently attended and often happen outside business hours, with time shifted rather than added on top of a full working day. Part of the role is making releases safe enough to run during the day.

### Scope of Role

- Own production infrastructure across cloud environments, containers, networking, and self-hosted servers.
- Run deployments and improve CI/CD pipelines, staged releases, migrations, and rollbacks.
- Operate datastores, including backups, restores, replication, upgrades, and capacity planning.
- Own observability across metrics, traces, logs, dashboards, and alerting.
- Carry primary on-call and build the runbooks, restore drills, escalation paths, and postmortem practices around it.
- Own security and access, including secrets management, patching, cloud and CI permissions, and least-privilege reviews.
- Replace repeated manual work with infrastructure as code.
- Manage infrastructure cost and capacity without compromising reliability.

### Key Success Indicators

- More infrastructure and access setup is documented, current, and managed as code.
- Backup, restore, and release processes are more reliable, better tested, and safer to run.
- On-call and incident response are more sustainable, with clearer alerts, stronger runbooks, and better follow-through on root causes.

## Requirements / Qualifications

### Must Have

**Professional expertise**

- 5+ years in DevOps, SRE, platform, or infrastructure engineering with real production ownership.
- Strong Linux fundamentals and confident shell scripting.
- Strong hands-on cloud experience, preferably AWS, across compute, networking, storage, and IAM.
- Strong hands-on experience with infrastructure as code (a hard requirement) and CI/CD ownership.
- Production experience with containers and orchestration, such as ECS, Kubernetes, or equivalent.
- PostgreSQL operations experience, including replication, backups, restores, upgrades, and production migrations.
- Practical experience with secure remote access, VPN or zero-trust mesh networking, SSH access models, and firewall policy.
- Experience as primary on-call for a production system, handling real incidents calmly.
- Strong observability and alerting judgment, with the ability to design alerts people trust.

**Communication and documentation**

- Documentation-first mindset.
- Able to keep runbooks, architecture notes, access lists, and SOPs current.
- Able to turn operational knowledge into clear written standards the team can follow.

As one of the first dedicated hires in this area, you will work closely with software engineers and product teams to define data standards, improve platform reliability, and build a scalable data foundation that supports analytics and future AI-driven initiatives.

Scope:

- **40% Data Architecture:** Partner with product and software engineering teams to design scalable data models, define architecture standards, and ensure clean data flows from source to consumption.
- **50% Data Engineering:** Build and optimize ETL/ELT pipelines, write performant SQL and transformation logic, and maintain data quality across TB-scale datasets.

Key responsibilities:

title: Junior Data Analyst (Python, SQL, R, Git)
description:
## Company

AI+DI builds measurement and certification infrastructure for human development outcomes, with the goal of making real improvements in people's lives verifiable and fundable. Its Data and Measurement team designs measurement instruments, processes data, validates results, and is responsible for the reliability of every figure the system produces. The current work centers on a measurement pilot for a mental health app.

## Details

- **Location:** Ho Chi Minh City
- **Level:** Junior
- **Work model:** On-site (at office)

## Responsibilities

The pilot runs three data channels in parallel:
- **In-app diary:** events and state labels from app features, with no conversation content.
- **Random prompts:** check-ins at randomly drawn times, used to correct for bias from users choosing when to open the app.
- **Weekly questionnaires:** three instrument sets completed outside the app, including one international scale that does not yet have a validated Vietnamese version.

**1. Build and operate the measurement pipeline**
- Turn formula specifications into code that runs correctly and reproducibly: scoring questionnaires, computing indicators from diary data, and joining the three channels by time window.
- Write data quality checks at every step, covering required-field completeness, out-of-range values, time zone mismatches, late-arriving events, and duplicate records.
- Build recurring reports for the research team and for the organization. Figures reported to the organization must always be aggregated.
- Work with the app's engineering team on event contracts: identify missing fields, labels that are inconsistent across versions, and logs that are insufficient to compute the promised indicators.

**2. Analysis and statistical validation**
- Run pre-registered analyses, including multilevel models for data repeated over weeks, models for ordinal and categorical outcomes, time-to-event analysis with censored data, and causal analysis for repeated randomized experiments within the app.
- Validate measurement instruments: reliability, factor structure, stability across weeks, and agreement between machine-assigned labels and human-verified labels.
- Address unavoidable issues in this type of data: non-random missingness, self-selected measurement timing, small per-person sample sizes, and multiple comparisons.
- Run simulations to estimate sample sizes and to test the analysis methods themselves before real data is available.
- Write the methods and results sections, including an honest limitations section, for internal documentation and for independent verification partners.

**3. Data governance and evidence integrity**
- Enforce privacy rules in code, not only in documentation: minimum aggregation thresholds, protection against inferring hidden subgroups, and separation of identifying data from analysis data.
- Maintain provenance for every figure, from raw records to the final indicator, including the code version and data version that produced it.
- Contribute to pre-registration documents, and record every change made after registration in an append-only log.
- Detect and report cases requiring safety intervention according to the defined procedure, within the committed timeframe.

## Requirements / Qualifications

**1. Statistics**
- A solid foundation in statistical inference: understand what a test does and does not establish, distinguish statistical significance from effect size, and understand why confidence intervals are often more useful than p-values.
- Repeated-measures data over time: multilevel or mixed-effects models, separating within-person variation from between-person differences.
- Non-continuous outcomes: logistic regression, models for ordinal outcomes, and models for count data.
- Missing data: distinguish missingness mechanisms and understand how each affects conclusions.
- Measurement: reliability, validity, measurement error, and why a scale translated into another language must be re-validated before use.
- Causal reasoning at a conceptual level: know when it is appropriate to say "causes" versus only "is associated with."

**2. Technology**
- Proficiency in Python or R, sufficient to write pipelines rather than only running one-off analyses in notebooks. Strong candidates are comfortable with both.
- SQL at a level sufficient to write queries across multiple tables, use window functions, and handle timestamped data.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
## Company

Everfit is a fitness coaching platform that provides an all-in-one, AI-powered platform for coaches to run and grow their businesses. It operates in the health and wellness B2B SaaS category, serves coaches worldwide, and is expanding toward direct-to-consumer offerings. Its team spans San Francisco and Vietnam.

## Details

- **Location:** Da Nang and Ha Noi, Vietnam
- **Level:** Not stated; requires 5+ years of relevant experience
- **Work model:** At office

## Responsibilities

You will train and adapt models using Everfit's product data and feedback, then take them into production. You will own the technical work from problem definition and data preparation through training, evaluation, release, and monitoring.

Some problems call for a small classifier or ranking model. Others may benefit from adapting a pretrained language or vision model. You will assess where training can improve quality, personalization, speed, or cost, recommend an approach, and test it against the current product.

You will work with Applied AI Engineers, Backend Engineers, Data Engineers, and product partners. Your focus will be training data, learned representations, model adaptation, evaluation, and the model lifecycle. Applied AI colleagues contribute the surrounding context, tools, and application workflows. Together, you will make sure model improvements reach users and solve the intended problem.

### Choose the problem and approach

- Work with product and domain partners to define the user problem, the decision a model should support, and how to measure a better result.
- Investigate whether errors come from the model, labels, missing context, reference data, or product integration.
- Compare the current workflow with simple baselines, existing models, and training-based approaches. Recommend the approach the evidence supports.

### Build data that supports learning

- Work with data engineers and domain experts to prepare training and evaluation datasets. Define labels, review disagreements, and check for missing records, duplicates, and uneven coverage.
- Turn product feedback into useful training examples. Check that a coach edit, click, purchase, or correction means what the training objective assumes.
- Keep training and evaluation separate. Use time, user, coach, or workspace boundaries where needed, and prevent future information from entering earlier examples.
- Test unfamiliar users and items, sparse histories, and important failure cases. Distinguish missing activity records from inactivity when working with engagement data.

### Train, adapt, and evaluate models

- Build task-specific models and adapt pretrained models where appropriate. Methods may include supervised fine-tuning (SFT), Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), distillation, and parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT), including low-rank adaptation (LoRA).
- Choose metrics that match the task. Examine ranking quality, per-category classification errors, language quality, or recognition and portion errors as appropriate.
- Check uncertainty and define when a model should abstain, request more information, or use a fallback. Review the consequences of different mistakes with product partners.
- Version datasets, labels, transformations, model artifacts, and evaluation settings so another engineer can reproduce the result.

### Deliver and improve the product

- Work with backend, data, and DevOps colleagues to deploy and serve models in batch or online services. Keep training and serving transformations consistent, and test the full path to the result users receive.
- Compare model quality with response time, memory use, and operating cost. Diagnose failures and make improvements without hiding regressions in an average score.
- Run controlled product experiments with the team. Measure useful outcomes alongside offline scores, and document what the evidence supports.
- Monitor model and data performance after release. Validate updates before deployment, maintain a rollback path, and turn confirmed failures into regression tests.
- Protect coach and client data in datasets, inference, and logs. Follow workspace access boundaries and approved retention and deletion rules.

## Requirements / Qualifications

**Skills and experience**

- Good English communication, with clear explanations of technical choices and limitations.
- 5+ years of relevant experience in Machine Learning,

title: IT Manager (Cloud, Cybersecurity, Networking)
description:
## Company

UOA Vietnam is the Vietnam operation of a group with headquarters and a central Group IT function. It manages corporate offices and premises and is preparing new office buildings, which places this role within a property and corporate-facilities context.

## Details

- **Location:** Ho Chi Minh City
- **Seniority/Level:** IT Manager (management level)
- **Work model:** On-site (at office)

## Responsibilities

**Job purpose:** Lead and oversee UOA Vietnam's corporate IT strategy and operations, ensuring a secure, reliable, resilient and cost-effective IT environment that supports business objectives and organisational growth. The IT Manager is responsible for IT planning, policies, budgeting, cybersecurity, risk management, vendor oversight and coordination with Group IT, while ensuring IT readiness for new office buildings and company premises.

### 1. Business Alignment and IT Planning
- Identify business needs and translate them into appropriate technology solutions, considering business value, risk, compliance, security, scalability and available resources.
- Develop and manage annual and multi-year IT plans, investment roadmaps and budgets; monitor expenditure, control costs and explain budget variances.
- Provide IT and security advice when evaluating, selecting and procuring technology solutions.
- Establish and maintain IT policies, standards, procedures and governance frameworks aligned with business needs and Group requirements.
- Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, service quality and business processes through technology.

### 2. Infrastructure and Systems Management
- Ensure the availability, performance, reliability and security of IT infrastructure and services, including network, server, cloud and connectivity services.
- Oversee Microsoft 365, business and project applications, LAN/WAN/Wi-Fi networks, servers, endpoints, identity and access management, and local IT services.
- Manage IT system maintenance, upgrades, configuration and documentation, ensuring appropriate system and asset records are maintained.
- Oversee backup, disaster recovery and IT business continuity arrangements, ensuring recovery plans are documented, tested periodically and updated as required.
- Monitor infrastructure capacity and performance, identify potential issues and implement preventive and corrective measures.

### 3. User Support and IT Service Management
- Lead IT service delivery, user support, incident management, problem resolution and escalation to ensure timely and effective service.
- Establish and monitor service levels, response times and service quality against agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs), where applicable.
- Handle major incidents, complex technical issues and escalations while delegating routine support activities to the IT Executive or external service providers.
- Identify recurring issues and implement improvements to reduce downtime and enhance the user experience.
- Maintain appropriate IT service documentation, procedures and user support guidelines.

### 4. Cybersecurity, Risk Management and Data Protection
- Oversee cybersecurity, identity and access controls, endpoint protection, data protection and information security in accordance with Group policies and applicable Vietnamese laws and regulations.

- Conduct regular IT security risk assessments, identify vulnerabilities and recommend appropriate mitigation measures.
- Establish and maintain security incident response procedures; coordinate and lead responses to cybersecurity incidents and data breaches, including escalation and reporting to relevant stakeholders.
- Promote information security awareness through employee training and communication on cybersecurity best practices.
- Evaluate and recommend security tools and technologies to strengthen the company's overall security posture.
- Ensure appropriate controls are in place for data backup, recovery, access management and the secure handling of company information.

title: Division Principal Games Programmer (Unreal Engine, AI)
description:
## Company

Gameloft is a video game developer and publisher. This role sits in its OTT programming division, which develops and co-develops live service games for mobile, PC, and console.

## Details

- **Location:** Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
- **Seniority/Level:** Division Principal (Games Programmer, Unreal Engine and AI)
- **Work model:** Hybrid, with 2 days of work from home per week

## Responsibilities

This role exists because reactive execution is no longer enough. The OTT programming division needs a technical authority who can shift the team's positioning from "a team that delivers what it is asked to build" to "a technical partner that other studios actively seek out because of the value it brings to a game's success." That requires someone who can set a long-term technical vision, build scalable production ecosystems across mobile, PC, and console, and drive focused R&D, including applied AI in game development, while ensuring flawless delivery across multiple live and co-development projects.

The challenge is dual: you will build toward the future while keeping current production healthy. You will need to anticipate what partner studios will need before they ask, identify and close skill gaps across a team of around 35 to 40 programmers, and establish technical standards that make the studio a reference point across the organization, not just a capable executor.

**Day-to-day responsibilities:**

- Monitor the technical health of multiple concurrent projects, working closely with technical leads to surface risks early, prevent bottlenecks, and keep deliveries on track.
- Define and enforce studio-wide coding standards, architectural patterns, and engineering workflows, and drive their adoption across programming teams.
- Lead high-impact R&D initiatives, with particular focus on AI applied to game development, and ensure successful integration of outcomes into production pipelines.
- Provide hands-on technical guidance and mentoring to programmers, conduct periodic competency assessments, and build clear development paths.
- Act as the primary technical counterpart for co-development partner studios, aligning on architecture, tooling, style guides, and Unreal toolchain standardization across shared pipelines.
- Collaborate cross-functionally with Game Design, Art, and Production to improve how programming integrates with other disciplines and contributes to overall product quality.
- Plan strategic resources and project allocation in partnership with the Studio Technical Director.

**Success in your first year:** You will have made a visible and assessable impact on at least one co-development project or on a strategic technical mission defined in line with the studio's long-term vision. That impact will be confirmed through calibration with multiple stakeholders across the organization, not through self-assessment alone.

**Reporting and collaboration:** You will report to the Studio Technical Director and work across a programming department of around 35 to 40 people at multiple seniority levels, supporting live service and co-development projects on mobile, PC, and console. You will make judgment calls with real consequences for security, uptime, and cost, often without anyone above you reviewing the details. You will also partner with the Operations team to reduce the internal IT friction that slows the rest of the company. As the platform evolves alongside new AI-powered features, you will help define what "platform" means and adapt to those changes without waiting to be told what has changed.

- **Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps (AWS):** Build, monitor, and scale the AWS infrastructure. Manage containerized environments (Docker/Kubernetes) using Terraform and Serverless. Manual "ClickOps" changes in the AWS console are not permitted.
- **Monitoring:** Monitor the platform using Grafana and AWS tools. Keep autoscaling ahead of traffic spikes. Identify problems before customers do.
- **Security:** Manage WAF and IAM roles, and implement the technical controls that keep the infrastructure audit-ready for SOC 2 and ISO. Enforce least privilege without slowing down the engineering team.
- **Zero-Downtime Deployments:** Continuously improve CI/CD pipelines to enable safe, automated testing. Make deployments routine.
- **Future Readiness:** As new AI-powered features ship, ensure the underlying platform (cost, latency, data handling) can support them, not just survive them.
- **Internal IT Automation:** Work with the Operations team to build a more self-service internal IT experience through API integrations, scripts (Python/JavaScript/etc.), and stronger SSO/IAM, so that manual support requests become the exception. This role focuses on building the automation and tooling behind IT operations; it is not the first point of contact for day-to-day IT support.

- Root cause focus: you investigate application logs and work with engineers to permanently fix issues such as memory leaks or database bottlenecks, rather than simply restarting servers.
- Question first: before automating or provisioning infrastructure, you assess why it is needed and what problem it solves, not only how to build it fastest.
- Automation mindset: you write real automation (for example, in Python or JavaScript) rather than ad hoc Bash glue code, and you script any task you perform more than once.
- Extreme ownership: you operate with high autonomy in a fast-paced environment and proactively identify and solve problems without waiting for tickets.
- Continuous learning: you keep up with new cloud, security, and AI infrastructure practices and adopt what is genuinely useful.
- Clear communication: you can explain complex AWS routing issues to engineers and guide non-technical colleagues through SaaS access problems in clear, confident English.

## Benefits

- Highly competitive salary plus a 13th-month bonus.
- Stock options for high contributors.
- Professional development package of up to $1,000 per year for courses, books, or conferences.
- Comprehensive healthcare package: annual health check, vaccinations, premium health insurance, and family health insurance.
- Flexible working hours with a standard five-day workweek.
- Professional equipment: MacBook Pro or Mac Studio, plus

The role is responsible for designing and overseeing the implementation of the bank's data governance policies, and for directly managing, controlling, and improving data quality, so that the bank's data is governed consistently and reliably enough to support business operations, management, reporting, and decision-making.

**1. Data Governance Policies, Regulations, and Framework**

- Develop, propose, and refine the bank's data governance policies, regulations, standards, and framework in line with the business strategy and data strategy of each period.
- Serve as the focal point for drafting and rolling out documents related to Data Governance, including governance mechanisms and the roles and responsibilities of Data Owners, Data Stewards, and other stakeholders.
- Develop principles, processes, and standards for managing critical data across the bank.
- Monitor and supervise compliance with issued data governance policies, regulations, and procedures.
- Propose programs, initiatives, and plans to strengthen data governance capability and reduce risks related to data use and management.
- Coordinate with business units, Technology, and Data Owners to implement and standardize data governance across the entire bank.

**2. Data Quality, Metadata, Business Glossary, and Data Protection**

- Work directly with the Data Platform team to build and deploy governance and data management solutions on the bank's data platform.

- Build, standardize, and manage the Business Glossary, ensuring business terms and data definitions are consistent across bank units.
- Coordinate the implementation of Data Protection requirements, including data classification, sensitivity levels, and principles for data access, use, and protection in accordance with bank regulations.
- Participate in building, deploying, and operating tools and systems that support Data Governance, Data Quality, Metadata Management, and Data Catalog.
- Support business units in accessing, using, and managing data through deployed tools and data platforms.

- 3–5 years of experience in data, including practical experience in one or more of the following: Data Governance, Data Quality, Metadata Management, Data Catalog, Business Glossary, Data Protection, or Data Management.
- Ability to work in both directions: developing governance policies and frameworks, and hands-on implementation of data governance on the data platform.
- Experience developing or implementing data governance/data management policies, regulations, standards, procedures, or frameworks.
- Direct experience with Data Quality, including building Data Quality Rules, Data Quality Metrics/KPIs, data quality control, error analysis, and handling data issues.
- Understanding of or practical experience with Metadata, Data Catalog, Business Glossary, and Data Lineage.

As a Technical Customer Support Associate, you will help customers solve technical issues with NamiTech's AI products, including Voicebot, Chatbot, Agent Scoring, Agent Assist, and Voice Biometrics. You will be the link between our customers and our Dev, QA, Infra, and Product teams.

No deep coding is required. Your job is to investigate issues by checking data, logs, and basic settings, resolve what you can, and bring in the right team when needed. You will be trained on our products before handling cases on your own.

- Receive customer requests from our ticket system and email, understand the issue, and determine its urgency.
- Keep each ticket up to date so customers and teammates always know where things stand, and make sure issues are handled on time.
- Investigate issues: try to reproduce them and check the user's account, service status, input data, and basic settings.

- Resolve common issues using our troubleshooting guides, or work with the Dev, QA, Infra, Product, or partner teams on more complex issues, and follow up until they are fixed.
- Keep customers updated in Vietnamese and English, explaining technical matters in simple, clear language.
- After training, handle common cases on your own and help improve our troubleshooting guides and FAQs.

### Out of scope

The following tasks are handled by our Dev, Infra, and technical teams:

- Fixing or changing source code.
- Designing system architecture or technical solutions.
- Changing live data or releasing updates to the live system (these always require approval).
- Confirming the final cause of a technical issue or promising fix dates to customers.

- Degree in IT, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related field. 0–2 years of experience; fresh graduates are welcome.

The System Architect defines, develops, and maintains complex automotive embedded systems and system-of-systems throughout the product lifecycle. The role requires a deep understanding of customer use cases, stakeholder needs, system behavior, internal and external interfaces, and functional architectures. The System Architect acts as the technical owner of the system concept and ensures that requirements, architecture, interfaces, and verification strategies are complete, consistent, traceable, and aligned with customer expectations and industry standards.

Beyond individual contributions, the System Architect provides technical leadership across multiple engineering disciplines, including System, Software, Hardware, Integration, Verification & Validation, Security, and Functional Safety teams. The role drives technical decisions, supports customer discussions, and ensures successful execution of system engineering activities in compliance with ASPICE and Bosch development processes.

### System Requirements Engineering

- Elicit, analyze, negotiate, document, and manage stakeholder requirements.

- Ensure consistency, completeness, feasibility, and verifiability of requirements.
- Define acceptance criteria and verification strategies for system requirements.
- Establish and maintain end-to-end traceability between stakeholder requirements, system requirements, architecture elements, and verification artifacts.
- Conduct impact analysis for requirement changes and coordinate implementation across affected domains.
- Review, approve, baseline, and release system requirements.

### System Architecture & Design

- Define and maintain system architecture for complex embedded systems and system-of-systems.
- Analyze functional, logical, and technical interactions between software, hardware, communication networks, cloud services, mobile applications, and vehicle systems.
- Identify, specify, and maintain system interfaces and interaction models.
- Lead architectural trade-off studies considering performance, safety, security, cost, maintainability, and customer expectations.
- Ensure architectural consistency across all engineering disciplines.
- Support architectural decomposition into hardware, software, and verification work products.

### Technical Leadership & Coordination

- Serve as technical lead for system engineering topics within projects.
- Coordinate system engineering activities across multiple teams and disciplines.
- Guide and mentor System Eng

- Write and maintain FastAPI endpoints for the agent backend, including streaming responses, WebSocket connections, Celery async tasks, and APIs that integrate with a React frontend.
- Practice prompt engineering and evaluation: design system prompts and few-shot examples, measure agent output quality using LangSmith, and continuously improve based on real-world data.
- Work with the frontend and product management teams to deploy agents into client environments, support onboarding, monitor performance, and handle incidents after go-live.
- Perform other tasks as assigned by management.

**Education**
- Graduated or about to graduate in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Mathematics and Informatics, or a related technical field.

**Required skills**
- **Python (proficient):** OOP, async/await, type hints, virtual environments, pip/poetry. Able to read and write clean Python code independently, without detailed step-by-step guidance.
- **LLMs and prompt engineering:** Experience communicating with LLMs through APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic). Understands tokens, temperature, system/user prompts, and few-shot prompting.
- **LangChain (basic):** Chains, PromptTemplate, LLM wrappers, and message history. Experience building a simple chatbot or RAG application through tutorials or学习 projects is an advantage.
- **FastAPI (basic):** Creating REST endpoints, Pydantic models, and reading FastAPI codebases. Production experience is not required, but must be able to run a local development server independently.
- **Git and GitHub:** Commits, branches, pull requests, and resolving conflicts. Daily experience collaborating in a team using Git.
- **Logical thinking and self-learning:** Willing to read technical documentation, debug by reading logs and stack traces, and experiment and fail fast.
- Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively in a team.
- Good English reading skills for technical material (documentation, GitHub issues, summarized research papers).

**Nice to have (not required, but preferred)**
- Experience building AI agents, RAG pipelines, or chatbots with tool use, including through tutorials or capstone projects.
- Understanding of LangGraph: nodes, edges, state machines, and conditional branching in workflows.
- Knowledge of vector databases (Qdrant, Pinecone, Chroma) and concepts such as embeddings and cosine similarity.
- Knowledge of the Model Context Protocol (MCP), an open standard for AI agent tool integration.
- Experience using Docker to package and run applications; basic familiarity with MongoDB.
- Knowledge of React and JavaScript, with the ability to read frontend code to help debug API integrations.

## Benefits

- Full social insurance, health insurance, and unemployment insurance contributions, as required by Vietnamese law.
- A young, friendly, dynamic work environment that encourages creativity.
- Team-building activities and company trips.

- Design and run security testing for the same systems, including direct and indirect prompt injection, excessive agency, tool/plugin abuse, and confused-deputy risks in agentic and Model Context Protocol (MCP)-style tool-calling architectures.
- Build and maintain a threat model covering the full path from user input through model reasoning to tool execution, identifying where a safety failure and a security failure share the same underlying gap.
- Verify that human-in-the-loop and guardrail controls are architecturally sound wherever an AI agent can take a consequential action, such as writing to a business system, sending an automated communication, or making a code change. Controls must not rely solely on a UI that can be circumvented.
- Scope, brief, and review the output of external red-teaming and penetration testing vendors, and write test specifications and acceptance criteria for AI-specific engagements.
- Track and apply emerging frameworks, including the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, the OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications, the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, ISO/IEC 42001, and the EU AI Act, and translate new research into concrete internal test requirements.
- Partner with AI/ML engineering teams across business units to have safety and security reviewed during system design, not only tested after the fact.
- Produce evidence and documentation supporting AI governance and compliance needs, including ISO/IEC 42001 AI management system documentation, EU AI Act risk assessments, and internal responsible-AI review processes.
- Build test tooling as needed, such as adversarial-prompt harnesses, automated jailbreak and red-team pipelines, and MCP/tool-schema fuzzers.
- Mentor engineers on safe and secure AI system design and grow the safety and security practice as it scales across teams and products.

## Requirements / Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field.
- 6+ years of experience in security testing, AI/ML safety research, or a closely related discipline, with a track record of finding real issues in real systems.
- Practical experience testing or red-teaming LLM and agentic AI systems, covering prompt injection, jailbreaks, excessive agency, and tool/plugin abuse. Independent research or open-source contributions are acceptable given how new this specialty is.
- Working knowledge of at least one AI safety or governance framework (NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, or EU AI Act) and how it translates into concrete engineering requirements.
- Coding ability in Python and/or JavaScript/Node.js sufficient to build evaluation harnesses and test tooling rather than relying solely on manual testing.
- Strong technical writing skills, with the ability to produce findings and specifications that engineers and governance/compliance stakeholders can act on directly.
- English proficiency for working in an English-speaking environment.

**Preferred qualifications:**

- Direct experience with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or comparable agent tool-calling frameworks.
- Traditional penetration testing background (web, API, or network), with OSCP or equivalent certification.
- Experience contributing to a formal AI governance or compliance program.
- Publications, CTF or red-team competition results, or open-source security too

title: Software Engineer (Fullstack, AI-Native)
description:
## Company

SkyLab, based in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. The posting does not describe the company's industry or products.

## Details

- **Level:** Mid to senior (5+ years building and running production software)
- **Reports to:** VP of Engineering
- **Work model:** On-site
- **Salary:** Not stated in the posting (compensation includes a competitive base salary, performance bonus, and equity participation)

## Responsibilities

You will work across the company's new and existing products and projects. You own the features you work on from technical design to production. You receive the product requirements, write the technical specification, plan the build, estimate and commit to your own dates, build the feature, and stay with it until it works in production. Nobody writes the design for you, and nobody breaks the work into tickets for you.

The engineering team uses AI coding tools every day, and this is expected. The role requires judgement around those tools: deciding what to build and how before generating any code, breaking down the work, recognising when the output is wrong, and being accountable for everything that ships under your name, regardless of who or what wrote it. Candidates who pass requirements to an AI tool and pass the result to review are not a fit. The team wants engineers who think the problem through, plan the work, deliver it, and use AI to do so faster.

### Design and plan

- Turn product requirements into a technical specification covering functional requirements, acceptance criteria, data model, service boundaries, state changes, and failure cases.
- Raise time, feasibility, and scope problems while the requirements are still being written, not after the build starts.
- Present your design at architecture review, defend the decisions, and change the design where the review finds real gaps.
- Break the build into tasks with hour estimates and due dates, and commit to them.

### Build and deliver

- Build the feature end to end, using AI tools where they help and your own judgement throughout.
- Keep the specification current as the design changes during the build, so QA and other engineers always work from the real design.
- Write tests that would fail if the behaviour were wrong. Passing tests and coverage numbers are the minimum, not proof that the code works.
- Review your own work before asking anyone else to, and attach evidence when you merge: the tests, the results, and what you checked.
- Report progress daily and raise a schedule slip on the day you identify it, stating what it affects and what you propose.
- Deploy, verify that the feature works in production, and fix what breaks. Work is considered done when it is verified working in production, not when it is merged.

### Work with the team

- Work with the product manager and QA engineer on your feature from requirements through release.
- Review other engineers' code, including AI-generated code, with the same care as your own.
- Document how the systems you build work so the next engineer can pick them up.

## Requirements / Qualifications

### Mindset and working style (in priority order)

1. **Thinks and plans before building.** Given an unclear request, asks the right questions, identifies what is missing, and produces a plan covering the data, edge cases, failure modes, and how to verify it works, before opening an AI tool. Able to show specifications or designs you have written.
2. **Works independently.** Takes a problem from requirements to production without someone directing each step. When stuck, comes with options and a recommendation rather than a question alone. Delivers on committed dates and says so early when unable to.
3. **Uses AI as a tool, not a substitute for understanding.** Uses Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or similar daily and knows where they fail, such as invented APIs and fields, wrong assumptions about data, race conditions, missing tenant or permission checks, and tests that pass without checking anything. Can explain every line shipped and show how AI tools have sped up real work and how you caught them being wrong.
4. **Has shipped and run real systems.** Has built software running in production and been responsible for it, including debugging live problems, reading log

description:
## Company

AIRR Labs is a fast-growing e-commerce and social commerce company that helps brands build connections with consumers across Southeast Asia. Its Technology team develops AI-powered platforms and internal products that automate complex workflows and support business operations at scale.

## Details

- **Location:** Ho Chi Minh City
- **Seniority/Level:** Backend Engineer (experience level not explicitly stated; minimum requirements call for 2–4 years of relevant experience)
- **Work model:** At office

## Responsibilities

As a Backend Engineer, you will design and build the systems that power the company's next-generation commerce solutions. The role builds backend services that convert e-commerce transaction and settlement data into accurate billing records, including financial calculations, reconciliation checks, batch processing, and ERP integrations, in collaboration with product, finance, and other engineers.

**What you will build:**

- **Settlement ingestion:** Import normalized order, refund, payout, wallet movement, and fee records from files, APIs, or object storage. Validate required fields, handle duplicates, and support corrected or reissued data.
- **Billing calculation engine:** Calculate per-order-item service fees, marketplace fee allocation, rebates, cost and margin adjustments, and bundle splits. Apply effective-dated contract terms and preserve the rate used for each calculation.
- **Reconciliation:** Match order totals, platform payouts, wallet transactions, fees, and calculated billing amounts. Build tolerance-based checks, exception records, and clear reasons for mismatches.
- **Batch workflows:** Implement settlement runs with status transitions, retries, reruns, approval gates, and safeguards against double-posting. Keep input, output, and run history traceable.
- **ERP-ready outputs:** Produce validated billing and accounting data with correct signs, currency handling, tax treatment as specified by Finance, reference IDs, and versioned integration schemas. Handle delivery failures and acknowledgments.
- **Finance operations APIs:** Build APIs for batch status, transaction search, exception investigation, fee mapping, manual adjustments, and invoice preview. Work with frontend engineers on operator-friendly tools.

**Day-to-day responsibilities:**

- Translate agreed finance rules into tested application logic, and clarify ambiguous calculations with Finance and Product before release.
- Design PostgreSQL tables, indexes, constraints, migrations, and queries for transaction-level records, batches, and audit events.
- Implement background jobs with safe retry behavior, idempotency keys, backfills, and structured logs.
- Write unit, integration, and data-quality tests using synthetic financial examples and edge cases such as partial refunds, missing fees, late settlements, and restatements.
- Investigate production discrepancies using logs and audit history, and fix root causes without silently altering posted financial records.
- Document APIs, calculation assumptions, operational runbooks, and deployment changes, and review code with the team.

## Requirements / Qualifications

**Minimum requirements:**

- 2–4 years of experience building production backend services in Python, TypeScript/Node.js, Java, or Go, with strong coding and debugging fundamentals.
- Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL or a similar relational database, including SQL, transactions, constraints, schema design, and performance tuning.
- Experience with REST APIs, asynchronous or background processing, message queues or workflow jobs, and reliable failure handling.
- Ability to use decimal-safe monetary arithmetic and write precise tests for rounding, totals, and edge cases.
- Experience with data pipelines or file-based ingestion (CSV, JSON, API feeds), including validation, deduplication, and reprocessing.
- Comfort working directly with non-engineering stakeholders to confirm requirements and investigate data issues.

**Nice to have:**

- Experience with e-commerce order, refund, marketplace payout, payment, ledger, or accounting integrations.
- Experience with reconciliation, invoice generation, billing systems, ERP interfaces, or financial data audit trails.
- Experience with cloud object storage, scheduled orchestration, containerized deployment, and observability tooling.

## Benefits

- Opportunity to work on

The Penetration Tester will join the AI Safety & Security team and work hands-on across Bosch's growing portfolio of AI-enabled products and internal tooling, including LLM deployments, agentic AI systems, and Model Context Protocol (MCP)-style tool-calling integrations. Working under the direction of the team's Lead AI Safety & Security Engineer, the role executes structured test plans against real systems. Testing covers both whether an AI system behaves safely (refusing harmful requests and staying within its intended scope) and whether it is secure (resistant to prompt injection and to being tricked into misusing its tools). **Automation Framework Ownership**

title: Junior Security Engineer
description:
## Company
