**Security Operations & Monitoring**
- Monitor security alerts, logs, and dashboards; triage and escalate findings to the Senior Security Lead as needed.
- Support day-to-day cloud security hygiene checks (primarily AWS, also GCP), such as IAM reviews, misconfiguration checks, and basic remediation.
- Help maintain security tooling and automation scripts used across the team.

**Application & Infrastructure Security Support**
- Assist with security architecture reviews for new and existing systems under senior guidance.
- Run and interpret basic SAST/DAST scans, and help track findings through to remediation with engineering teams.
- Support secure configuration of containerized environments (Docker).
- Assist, where opportunities arise, with Kubernetes and CI/CD pipeline security, and review AI-driven features or LLM integrations for common risks (e.g., prompt injection, data leakage) under senior guidance. Exposure to this work will grow over time and is not expected on day one.

**Incident Response & Testing Support**
- Support incident response activities, including gathering logs, documenting timelines, and assisting with remediation tasks under the direction of the Senior Security Lead.
- Assist with penetration testing and red-team exercises (internal or vendor-led), including evidence collection and findings tracking.
- Coordinate logistics with external vendors and consultants when supporting pentesting or peak-demand engagements.

**Collaboration & Growth**
- Work with engineering teams to communicate security findings clearly and help get fixes prioritized.
- Take on structured learning goals (certifications, tooling, frameworks) with support and mentorship from the Senior Security Lead.
- Document processes, runbooks, and findings to build the team's institutional knowledge.

## Requirements / Qualifications

**General Qualifications**
- 1–2 years of experience in security engineering, IT, software engineering, or a related technical field. Internships and hands-on personal or academic projects count.
- Genuine interest in security engineering and a desire to grow into a hands-on technical role.
- Able to communicate findings clearly in writing, and comfortable asking questions and seeking guidance.
- Degree or equivalent practical experience in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field. Relevant certifications (e.g., Security+, eJPT) are a plus but not required.

**Technical Skills**
- Basic understanding of cloud fundamentals (AWS preferred; GCP a plus), including IAM, networking, and common services.
- Familiarity with at least one scripting or programming language (e.g., Python, Bash, Go) for automation tasks.
- Exposure to or coursework in application security concepts (OWASP Top 10, common vulnerability classes).
- Basic familiarity with containerized environments (Docker) and version control (Git). Kubernetes exposure is a plus.
- Curiosity about AI/LLM security concepts is a plus. Prior experience is not required.

**Team & Collaboration**
- Comfortable working under supervision, taking direction, and escalating issues appropriately rather than guessing under pressure.
- Willing to learn Zalora's and GFG's security standards and apply them consistently in day-to-day work.
- Able to collaborate with engineering teams across time zones and markets.

## Benefits

- Annual bonus of up to 3 months' base salary
- 13th-month salary
- MacBook Pro or laptop provided at the start of employment
- Social insurance, medical insurance, and health insurance
- 15 days of annual leave
- 30 days of sick leave / mental health leave
- 1 day of occasion leave
- Hybrid working environment
- Clear career progression plan and support

## Responsibilities

The Data Engineering team is moving the platform from one built primarily on BigQuery to a hybrid lakehouse across cloud and on-premise infrastructure. The shift supports stronger data control, lower cost, and regulatory compliance, and it raises engineering problems at every layer: ingestion and replication across environments, data models that deploy to more than one platform, distributed storage and compute on Kubernetes and bare metal, and separating workloads by data sensitivity. You do not need experience in every area below.

Areas you could work in:

- **Data ingestion and modeling:** Batch and streaming ingestion from databases, backend services, and Kafka; replication between BigQuery and the lakehouse; and layered data models in dbt and Spark that serve reporting, analytics, and machine learning.
- **Data infrastructure:** Lakehouse storage on Apache Iceberg and object storage; compute engines such as Spark and StarRocks on Kubernetes; multi-tenancy, performance, and cost.
- **Data platform engineering:** Reliability, observability, incident response, and tooling that automates platform operations across cloud and on-premise.
- **Data governance:** Access control, PII separation, data contracts, and tools that keep the platform compliant.

Day-to-day responsibilities:

- Design and run batch and streaming pipelines across cloud and on-premise, with incremental loads, safe re-runs, and backfills.
- Design data models and storage layouts that hold up as data volume and business requirements grow.
- Tune Spark and other distributed engines, and fix inefficient jobs rather than adding more resources.
- Build monitoring, alerts, and runbooks, and lead root-cause analysis so the same incident does not happen twice.
- Migrate pipelines and models from BigQuery to the new lakehouse without breaking what is already in use.
- Help separate PII and PII-free workloads with appropriate access controls.
- Build tools and frameworks that other engineers and teams use to ship data faster.

## Requirements / Qualifications

Must have:

- 2+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Platform Engineering, or a related backend or infrastructure role, with production systems you built or ran.
- Strong SQL and hands-on experience with at least one of Python, Java, or Scala.

title: Lead QA/QC Engineer - Test Design (IoT product)
description:
## Company

Safetrust develops IoT products spanning mobile apps, web portals, APIs, and physical devices.

## Details

- **Location:** Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
- **Seniority/Level:** Lead
- **Work model:** At office

## Responsibilities

The Lead Quality Engineer - Test Strategy & Design is responsible for the design, structure, and continuous quality of Safetrust's test cases and test documentation across mobile, web, API, and device platforms. This role is a key part of the QA organization and serves as the source of truth for what is tested, how it is described, and how a release is proven ready to ship.

The role focuses on test design leadership and documentation ownership. It works as a peer to the Test Automation Lead, who owns frameworks and CI infrastructure, and ensures test coverage scales rigorously as the product grows.

### Test Case Design Ownership

- Own the end-to-end test case design strategy across mobile apps, web portals, APIs, and IoT devices.
- Define and enforce standards for how test cases are written: structure, granularity, preconditions, expected results, and traceability to requirements.
- Review and approve test cases authored by QA engineers, and coach the team on test design techniques (boundary value analysis, equivalence partitioning, decision tables, state transition, risk-based testing, and exploratory charters).
- Maintain a master test case library that is organized, deduplicated, version-controlled, and tagged for reuse across releases and product lines.
- Drive coverage analysis by mapping test cases to requirements, user stories, and risk areas; identify gaps and prioritize remediation.
- Define and maintain reusable test data sets, environments, and fixtures that test cases depend on.
- Establish enterprise-wide quality standards, testing methodologies, and governance across all Safetrust engineering teams.
- Partner with Engineering, Product Management, Security, and Customer Success to incorporate quality objectives throughout the software development lifecycle.
- Define release quality gates, risk acceptance criteria, and go/no-go recommendations for production deployments.
- Develop and maintain quality dashboards measuring defect trends, release readiness, customer-reported issues, automation coverage, and engineering quality metrics.
